summary: The new Preview warm-up request cannot access protected Preview deployments, so it can fail the required Lighthouse job before Lighthouse runs.
requires: The Vercel Preview deployment is protected by Vercel Authentication, as the Lighthouse configuration supports.
evidence: The Lighthouse step receives VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET and configures the x-vercel-protection-bypass header, but the new curl step receives neither the secret nor that header; curl --fail then treats the protection response as a failed warm-up.
